# analogical target

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:analogicalTarget`](gmeow-analogicalTarget.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/analogicalTarget>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The target domain of a [`gmeow:Analogy`](../classes/gmeow-Analogy.md) — the less-familiar structure that inherits relations from the source via the correspondences. NOT functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Analogy`](../classes/gmeow-Analogy.md) -> `?`

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:analogicalTarget`](gmeow-analogicalTarget.md) from [`gmeow:Analogy`](../classes/gmeow-Analogy.md) to `?` when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

```turtle

# --- The reified analogy (a relator) ---------------------------------------- #

    rdfs:label "The atom is like the solar system"@en ;
    gmeow:analogicalSource ex:solarSystem ;
    gmeow:analogicalTarget ex:atom ;
    gmeow:hasCorrespondence ex:corrCentral , ex:corrOrbiting ;
    gmeow:systematicity "0.80"^^xsd:decimal .     # solver-layer (Gentner structural consistency)
```
